meta.title: Harness2: two coupled recursion levels over an open-world task stream

system.name: Harness2
system.one_liner: a plug-and-play framework that refines an agent's execution harness for the current task via a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose step, and reflects on each refinement to update an improvement harness that guides future tasks

materials: no bitmaps: all icons drawn from the parts library as vector robot heads, file stacks and snowflakes
ai.notes: two full-width bands. Top band (blue tint): the open-world task stream strip above it; inside, a four-stage pipeline Agent Executor -> Harness Editor -> Candidate Probes -> Harness Composer ending in the accent Final Harness box, with the two proposed candidates drawn as two small cards under the Editor and a budget-k pill below. Bottom band (purple tint): Reflector -> Improvement Harness box holding the library (adopted harnesses + lessons), fixed during a task (snowflake), updated after each task. Dashed cross-task arrows couple the bands: improvement record down, lessons up, and a return arc to the task stream.

meta.caption_draft: Figure 1. Harness2 couples two recursion levels. For each open-world task q_t (no ground-truth verifier), task-level recursion runs the current execution harness for a reference trajectory, proposes invariant and domain-specific candidate harnesses, probes them on the same task for behavioral contrasts, and composes a final harness. Harnessing-level recursion then reflects on the improvement record to update the improvement harness's library, which informs the proposals of subsequent tasks.

steps.text: run the current harness for a reference trajectory
propose invariant and domain-specific candidate harnesses
probe each candidate on the same task for behavioral contrasts
compose the final harness from the evidence

notes: Read the top strip left to right (q_1 ... q_N, the outer return arc closes over it), then the blue band left to right through steps 1-4 to the accent Final Harness box, then step down the dashed improvement-record arrow into the purple band, and close the loop along the dashed inform arrow and the next-task arc. The two bands are the two recursion levels; their tints are the only region colours. The Final Harness box is the single saturated fill; every other fill is pale. The frozen snowflake appears twice (model chip, improvement harness note).
